assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome and supraventricular tachycardia.
The patient has a history of atherosclerotic heart disease.
The patient has intermittent symptomatic arrhythmias.
The service is cardiac event monitoring with CPT code 93271.
The diagnosis code I49.5 is associated with the patient's condition.
The diagnosis code I47.1 is associated with the patient's condition.
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204.
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan.
The patient has the right to file an appeal.
